mechanism_evidence.contract: copy_empty_like returns an empty circuit with invalidated parameter cache; the copy shares no parameter-cache identity with the original, mutations through one are invisible through the other, captured at copy timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Fill parameter cache via .parameters, then copy_empty_like/copy and mutate one side.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: empty-like copy carries over the cached parameter list; is-identity holds (shared) and empty check fails.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Invalidate parameter cache (cpy._parameters = None) after copying.

discriminating_observation.description:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit import Parameter
a=Parameter('a')
qc1=QuantumCircuit(1)
qc1.rz(a,0)
_ = qc1.parameters
cpy=qc1.copy_empty_like()
print('cache_identity', cpy._parameters is qc1._parameters, cpy._parameters is None)
assert cpy._parameters is not qc1._parameters, 'empty-like copy shares parameter cache'
assert cpy._parameters is None, 'cache not invalidated'
assert set(cpy.parameters)==set(), set(cpy.parameters)
qc3=qc1.copy()
qc3.rz(Parameter('b'),0)
assert set(qc1.parameters)=={a}, set(qc1.parameters)
print('f2_copy_empty_like_isolation', True)

triple.is_identity: cpy._parameters is not qc1._parameters (None vs list)
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: qc3.rz(b) invisible via qc1; qc1.rz(c) invisible via qc3; cpy empty
